q: Ciri ruang terkurung TIDAK termasuk:
c: Direka khusus sebagai tempat kerja utama
w: Boleh mempunyai atmosfera dengan pencemar berbahaya
e: Definition (ICOP 2010): enclosed or partially enclosed; atmospheric pressure during occupancy; NOT intended primarily as a place of work; may have harmful contaminants, O₂ deficiency/excess, engulfment; restricted entry/exit.

q: Menurut ICOP 2010, ruang terkurung boleh menyebabkan 'engulfment' iaitu:
c: Pekerja ditenggelami atau ditelan oleh bahan seperti cecair atau butiran
e: Confined space is liable to: harmful contaminants, oxygen deficiency or excess, cause engulfment, restricted entry/exit.

q: Sebelum kerja dalam ruang terkurung, keselamatan alatan tangan dan elektrik perlu dipastikan:
e: Before starting: isolate valves with LOTO, exhaust system if applicable, ensure suitability of hand and electric tools with the task.

q: Mengutip sampel gas, cecair atau habuk untuk ujian dalam ruang terkurung ialah aktiviti:
e: Activities: clearing & cleaning, welding, painting, inspection, replacement, repair, measurement/sampling.

q: Membuang enap cemar, sisa, minyak atau bahan kimia dari tangki ialah aktiviti:
e: Clearing and cleaning works: removing sludge, waste, oil or chemicals.

q: Menukar pam, injap atau bahagian mekanikal di dalam ruang terkurung ialah aktiviti:
e: Replacement of equipment: changing pumps, valves or mechanical parts inside confined spaces.

q: Metana dan propana dalam ruang terkurung dikategorikan sebagai:
e: Chemical hazards: toxic gases (H₂S, CO, ammonia), flammable gases (methane, propane), O₂ deficiency/enrichment, chemical residues.

q: Tekanan haba akibat pengudaraan lemah dan pencahayaan yang kurang dalam ruang terkurung ialah bahaya:
e: Physical hazard: heat stress due to poor ventilation, noise, poor lighting and visibility.

q: Serangan tikus, ular atau tebuan di ruang terkurung dikategorikan sebagai bahaya:
e: Biological hazard: bacteria, fungi, viruses in sewage; mold; animal/insect infestations (rats, snakes, wasps).

q: Kesan bahaya psikososial dalam ruang terkurung termasuk:
c: Kebimbangan, serangan panik dan kurang tumpuan
e: Psychosocial hazard effects: anxiety, panic attacks, reduced focus leading to mistakes.

q: Postur badan janggal akibat ruang sempit ialah bahaya:
e: Ergonomic hazard: awkward body positions due to narrow space, manual handling, repetitive or forceful tasks.

q: Suhu melampau (panas atau sejuk) dalam ruang terkurung boleh menyebabkan:
e: Environmental hazard: flooding, poor ventilation leading to gas accumulation, extreme temperatures – drowning, hypothermia, heat exhaustion.

q: Dalam tragedi Lenggong (6 April 2025), salah seorang mangsa ialah:
e: Lenggong: three died in a sealed sewer shaft at a resort construction site – two daily wage workers and one member of the public who attempted a rescue.

q: Dalam kes lurang Ipoh, mangsa terjatuh semasa:
e: Ipoh: workers conducting cleaning works fell while descending the stairs into the culvert; not wearing any respiratory equipment.

q: Dalam insiden di Sibu, kedua-dua mangsa ditemui di dalam:
c: Ruang sempit di dalam badan tongkang (barge)
e: Sibu (May 23): two workers fell into a narrow 12-foot-deep confined space inside a barge; suspected toxic gas inhalation.

q: Dalam insiden Cyberjaya, sebelum operasi menyelamat dimulakan, pasukan Hazmat:
c: Mengesahkan kehadiran gas di dalam lubang
e: Cyberjaya: two workers died in a 12-metre-deep hole; Hazmat confirmed the presence of gas before commencing the rescue.

q: Pihak yang mematuhi prosedur, memakai PPE dan mengekalkan hubungan dengan SP ialah:
e: Duties: AE – follows procedures, wears PPE, maintains contact with SP; ES – manages entry, cancels permit; PI – verifies, issues, suspends permit.

q: Sebelum kerja dimulakan, gas berbahaya dan pencemar perlu:
c: Disingkirkan (purge) dan pengudaraan yang mencukupi dipastikan
e: Planning before starting: purge hazardous gas/pollutants, ensure ventilation, warning signages and fencing, fire prevention equipment near entrance.

q: Sebelum kerja, pasukan tindak balas kecemasan perlu:
c: Ditubuhkan bersama first aider dan peralatan kecemasan
w: Ditempatkan di pejabat utama yang jauh
e: Before starting: establish emergency response team, first aiders and equipment; ES and SP to monitor and record AE names; provide PPE.

q: Semasa kerja dalam ruang terkurung, komunikasi yang baik mesti dikekalkan antara:
e: During works: good communication between SP and AE, sufficient continuous ventilation, immediate emergency response.
